example: You are absolutely right about that.
description: 你在那件事上完全正確。

example: He has a brilliant academic record.
description: 他有優異的學術成績。

example: You need a password to access the files.
description: 你需要密碼才能存取這些檔案。

example: I need to open a new bank account.
description: 我需要開一個新的銀行帳戶。

example: Getting the job was a great achievement for her.
description: 獲得這份工作對她來說是一項了不起的成就。

example: I saw an ad for a new car on TV.
description: 我在電視上看到一則新車廣告。

example: The new baby is a wonderful addition to the family.
description: 這個新生兒是家庭中美好的新成員。

example: She works in the school administration.
description: 她在學校的行政部門工作。

example: I really admire your courage.
description: 我非常欽佩你的勇氣。

example: He refused to admit that he was wrong.
description: 他拒絕承認自己錯了。

example: This is an advanced English course.
description: 這是一門進階（高級）英文課程。

example: I would advise you to see a doctor.
description: 我會建議你去看看醫生。

example: I can't afford to buy a new computer right now.
description: 我現在買不起新電腦。

example: Go straight ahead for about 100 meters.
description: 向前直走大約一百公尺。

example: The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night.
description: 火警警報器在半夜響了。

example: Have you heard their new album?
description: 你聽過他們的新專輯了嗎？

example: It's illegal to sell alcohol to minors.
description: 向未成年人出售酒類是違法的。

example: This drink is non-alcoholic.
description: 這種飲料不含酒精。

example: Do you have an alternative plan?
description: 你有替代計畫嗎？

example: I was amazed by the beautiful view.
description: 我被那美景驚呆了。

example: His ambition is to become a famous actor.
description: 他的抱負是成為一名著名的演員。

example: The company will announce its results tomorrow.
description: 公司將在明天宣布其業績。

example: I saw the announcement on the notice board.
description: 我在佈告欄上看到了公告。

example: Stop it! You're starting to annoy me.
description: 夠了！你開始讓我煩躁了。

example: She was annoyed with him for being late.
description: 她因為他遲到而感到惱火。

example: It's very annoying when the Wi-Fi is slow.
description: 當 Wi-Fi 很慢時，真的很討厭。

example: They live miles apart.
description: 他們住在相隔數英里的地方。

example: You should apologize for what you said.
description: 你應該為你所說的話道歉。

example: I've sent off my job application.
description: 我已經寄出了我的求職申請。

example: I have an appointment with the dentist at 3:00.
description: 我三點跟牙醫有預約。

example: I really appreciate your help.
description: 我非常感激你的幫助。

example: The flight will take approximately three hours.
description: 飛行大約需要三個小時。

example: The police arrested the thief.
description: 警方逮捕了那名小偷。

example: We are waiting for the arrival of the train.
description: 我們正在等待火車抵達。

example: He was asked to assist the manager.
description: 他被要求協助經理。

example: Have you finished the school assignment?
description: 你完成學校作業了嗎？

example: Don't forget to attach the file to the email.
description: 別忘了在電子郵件中附加檔案。

example: The Eiffel Tower is a popular tourist attraction.
description: 艾菲爾鐵塔是一個熱門的觀光景點。

example: He has a very positive attitude toward work.
description: 他對工作有非常積極的態度。

example: The government is the highest authority.
description: 政府是最高權威機構。

example: The car has an automatic door.
description: 這輛車有自動門。

example: The light turns on automatically at night.
description: 電燈在晚上會自動開啟。

example: The cost will average about $50 per person.
description: 每人的費用平均約為 50 美元。

example: I wasn't aware of the problem.
description: 我之前沒意識到這個問題。

example: Go away and leave me alone!
description: 走開，讓我一個人靜靜！

example: She took a step backward to see the picture better.
description: 她後退了一步以便看清楚那張畫。

example: I decided to bake a chocolate cake for his birthday.
description: 我決定為他的生日烤一個巧克力蛋糕。

example: It is important to keep a balance between work and life.
description: 在工作與生活之間保持平衡是很重要的。

example: The government decided to ban smoking in public places.
description: 政府決定禁止在公共場所吸菸。

example: We sat on the bank of the river and watched the sunset.
description: 我們坐在河岸邊看夕陽。

example: This company has its base in New York.
description: 這家公司的總部（基地）設在紐約。

example: I only have a basic knowledge of French.
description: 我只有法語的基礎知識。

example: We meet on a regular basis to discuss the project.
description: 我們定期（以此為基礎）會面討論專案。

example: My phone's battery is dead; I need a charger.
description: 我手機的電池沒電了，我需要充電器。

example: They won the battle, but the war continued.
description: 他們贏得了那場戰鬥，但戰爭還在持續。

example: She was famous for her great beauty.
description: 她以其驚人的美貌聞名。

example: A bee is busy collecting honey from flowers.
description: 一隻蜜蜂正忙著從花中採集蜂蜜。

example: It is my belief that everyone can succeed.
description: 我的信念是每個人都能成功。

example: I rang the bell, but no one came to the door.
description: 我按了鈴，但沒人來開門。

example: You have to bend your knees when you lift heavy boxes.
description: 搬重物時你必須彎曲膝蓋。

example: The new law will benefit many small companies.
description: 新法律將使許多小公司受益。

example: Does your dog bite?
description: 你的狗會咬人嗎？

example: A fallen tree is blocking the road.
description: 一棵倒下的樹阻斷了道路。

example: We will board the plane at Gate 5.
description: 我們將在 5 號登機門上飛機。

example: The bomb was found in a bag.
description: 炸彈是在一個袋子裡發現的。

example: You need a passport to cross the border.
description: 穿過國界（邊境）需要護照。

example: I'm sorry to bother you, but could you help me?
description: 很抱歉打擾你，但你能幫我一下嗎？

example: I need to go to the local branch of the bank.
description: 我需要去那家銀行的當地分行。

example: What brand of coffee do you prefer?
description: 你比較喜歡哪個品牌的咖啡？

example: It was very brave of him to save the child.
description: 他救了那個孩子，真是太勇敢了。

example: Take a deep breath and relax.
description: 深呼吸一下，放輕鬆。

example: It's difficult to breathe at high altitudes.
description: 在高海拔地區很難呼吸。

example: His breathing became slow and regular.
description: 他的呼吸變得很慢且有規律。

example: The bride looked beautiful in her white dress.
description: 新娘穿著白色禮服看起來很漂亮。

example: Children love blowing soap bubbles.
description: 孩子們喜歡吹肥皂泡泡。

example: Their dog is buried in the garden.
description: 他們的狗埋在花園裡。

example: A car drove by and splashed me with water.
description: 一輛車開過，濺了我一身水。

example: The cable for the internet is broken.
description: 網路電纜斷了。

example: Please try to stay calm.
description: 請試著保持冷靜。

example: They launched a new advertising campaign.
description: 他們發起了一項新的廣告活動。

example: I had to cancel my flight.
description: 我不得不取消我的航班。

example: Smoking increases the risk of lung cancer.
description: 吸菸會增加患肺癌的風險。

example: There are three candidates for the job.
description: 這份工作有三位候選人。

example: Don't forget to put the cap back on the bottle.
description: 別忘了把瓶蓋蓋回去。

example: The captain of the team was very proud.
description: 隊隊長感到非常自豪。

example: It was careless of you to leave the window open.
description: 你沒關窗戶真是太粗心了。

example: This book falls into the category of science fiction.
description: 這本書屬於科幻小說類別。

example: The ceiling of the room is very high.
description: 房間的天花板很高。

example: We had a big celebration after the win.
description: 獲勝後我們舉行了盛大的慶祝活動。

example: The talk will center on the new project.
description: 這次談話將以新專案為中心。

example: The hotel is in a central location.
description: 這家飯店位於市中心位置。

example: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
description: 婚禮儀式非常漂亮。

example: He owns a chain of restaurants.
description: 他擁有一家連鎖餐廳。

example: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
description: 學習一門新語言是一個巨大的挑戰。

example: He is the world chess champion.
description: 他是世界西洋棋冠軍。

example: What's on the other channel?
description: 另一個頻道在演什麼？

example: I just finished the first chapter of the book.
description: 我剛看完這本書的第一章。

example: How much do you charge for delivery?
description: 你們收多少運費？

example: You can buy fruit very cheap here.
description: 你可以在這裡買到非常便宜的水果。

example: He was caught trying to cheat in the exam.
description: 他在考試中企圖作弊被抓住了。

example: She has a very cheerful personality.
description: 她有著非常開朗的個性。

example: The chemical industry is very important.
description: 化學工業非常重要。

example: He felt a pain in his chest.
description: 他感到胸部疼痛。

example: I spent my childhood in the countryside.
description: 我的童年在農村度過。

example: He claims that he saw a UFO.
description: 他聲稱他看到了一個不明飛行物。

example: There is a special clause in the contract.
description: 合約中有一項特殊條款。

example: The sky cleared after the rain.
description: 雨後天空放晴（變清澈）了。

example: He is a very clever boy.
description: 他是個非常聰明的男孩。

example: Click on the link to open the page.
description: 點擊連結開啟頁面。

example: We have a meeting with an important client.
description: 我們要與一位重要的客戶開會。

example: It was a difficult climb to the top.
description: 爬到山頂是很艱難的過程。

example: He sat close to the fire.
description: 他坐在靠近火的地方。

example: Use a soft cloth to clean the screen.
description: 用一塊軟布清潔螢幕。

example: The police are looking for clues.
description: 警方正在尋找線索。

example: He coaches the school football team.
description: 他指導學校足球隊。

example: Coal is used to produce electricity.
description: 煤炭被用來發電。

example: I found a coin on the street.
description: 我在街上撿到一個硬幣。

example: He has a large collection of stamps.
description: 他有豐富的郵票收藏。

example: He used colored pencils to draw.
description: 他用彩色鉛筆繪畫。

example: I prefer not to comment on the matter.
description: 我不願對此事發表評論。

example: The town has many commercial buildings.
description: 這個小鎮有許多商業建築。

example: He was sent to prison for committing a crime.
description: 他因犯罪被送進監獄。

example: Communication is key in any relationship.
description: 在任何關係中，溝通都是關鍵。

example: The comparison between the two products is clear.
description: 這兩件產品之間的比較很明顯。

chinese: 競爭激烈的、有競爭力的
example: The job market is very competitive.
description: 就業市場競爭非常激烈。

example: Our main competitor is a Japanese company.
description: 我們主要的競爭對手是一家日本公司。

example: I wish to make a complaint about the service.
description: 我想對這項服務進行投訴。

example: It's a complex problem with no easy answer.
description: 這是一個沒有簡單答案的複雜問題。

example: The bus runs daily.
description: 這班公車每天運行。

example: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
description: 暴風雨對屋頂造成了嚴重的損害。

example: We made a deal to buy the car.
description: 我們達成了一項買車的協議（交易）。

example: He has lived here for a decade.
description: 他已經在這裡住了十年。

example: He dug deep into the ground.
description: 他往地下深挖。

example: It is difficult to define "love".
description: 要給「愛」下定義是很困難的。

example: I need a definite answer by tomorrow.
description: 我明天之前需要一個確定的答覆。

example: What is the definition of this word?
description: 這個單字的定義是什麼？

example: They deliver mail every morning.
description: 他們每天早上遞送郵件。

example: Our departure was delayed by two hours.
description: 我們的出發時間延誤了兩小時。

example: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
description: 儘管下雨，我們還是去散步了。

example: We finally reached our destination.
description: 我們終於到達了目的地。

example: Your attitude will determine your success.
description: 你的態度將決定你的成功。

example: She is determined to win the race.
description: 她下定決心要贏得比賽。

example: This is a new development in technology.
description: 這是科技領域的一項新發展。

example: The diagram shows how the machine works.
description: 這張圖解顯示了機器是如何運作的。

example: She wore a beautiful diamond ring.
description: 她戴著一只漂亮的鑽石戒指。

example: I had great difficulty finding the house.
description: 我在找那間房子時遇到了很大的困難。

example: Can you direct me to the station?
description: 你能指引我去車站的路嗎？

example: He looked directly at me.
description: 他直接看著我。

example: His shoes were covered in dirt.
description: 他的鞋子上沾滿了泥土。

example: One disadvantage of the city is the noise.
description: 這座城市的一個缺點是噪音。

example: I was disappointed with the test results.
description: 我對考試結果感到失望。

example: The movie was very disappointing.
description: 這部電影令人非常失望。

example: Students can get a 10% discount.
description: 學生可以獲得九折（10%）優惠。

example: I dislike eating spicy food.
description: 我不喜歡吃辣的食物。

example: He lives in the business district.
description: 他住在商業區。

example: We should divide the cake into eight pieces.
description: 我們應該把蛋糕分成八塊。

example: I watched a documentary about wild animals.
description: 我看了一部關於野生動物的紀錄片。

example: Please donate money to the charity.
description: 請捐款給慈善機構。

example: The price of gas has doubled.
description: 汽油價格漲了兩倍。

example: I have no doubt that he is telling the truth.
description: 我毫不懷疑他在說實話。

example: He got dressed quickly and went out.
description: 他迅速穿好衣服然後出門了。

example: The earthquake destroyed many old buildings.
description: 地震摧毀了許多老舊建築。

example: We visited several towns in eastern Europe.
description: 我們參觀了東歐的幾個城鎮。

example: The country is facing an economic crisis.
description: 這個國家正面临經濟危機。

example: Tourism is important for the local economy.
description: 觀光業對當地經濟非常重要。

example: Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
description: 不要站得離懸崖邊緣太近。

example: She works as an editor for a fashion magazine.
description: 她在一家時尚雜誌社擔任編輯。

example: It's important to educate children about healthy eating.
description: 教育孩子健康飲食是很重要的。

example: He is a highly educated man.
description: 他是一個受過高等教育的人。

example: We went on an educational trip to the museum.
description: 我們去博物館進行了一次有教育意義的旅行。

example: This is an effective way to learn new words.
description: 這是學習新單字的一個有效方法。

example: You need to communicate effectively with your team.
description: 你需要與你的團隊進行有效的溝通。

example: You must make an effort to arrive on time.
description: 你必須努力準時到達。

example: Who do you think will win the election?
description: 你認為誰會贏得這場選舉？

example: Customer service is a key element of our success.
description: 客戶服務是我們成功的關鍵要素。

example: I was embarrassed when I forgot her name.
description: 當我忘記她的名字時，我感到很尷尬。

example: It was an embarrassing mistake.
description: 那是一個令人尷尬的錯誤。

example: Call emergency services only in an emergency.
description: 只有在緊急情況下才撥打緊急服務電話。

example: He showed no emotion when he heard the news.
description: 當他聽到那個消息時，沒有表現出任何情緒。

example: She is looking for full-time employment.
description: 她正在尋找全職工作。

example: Could you empty the trash can, please?
description: 你能幫忙倒空垃圾桶嗎？

example: My parents always encourage me to try new things.
description: 我的父母總是鼓勵我嘗試新事物。

example: He was captured by the enemy.
description: 他被敵人抓住了。

example: They got engaged last month.
description: 他們上個月訂婚了。

example: He is studying engineering at college.
description: 他在大學攻讀工程學。

example: The clown entertained the children for hours.
description: 小丑逗孩子們開心了好幾個小時。

example: The city offers a wide range of entertainment.
description: 這座城市提供多種娛樂活動。

example: I'll meet you at the main entrance.
description: 我會在主入口（大門口）跟你碰面。

example: Entry to the museum is free.
description: 進入博物館是免費的。

example: We are discussing environmental issues.
description: 我們正在討論環境議題。

chinese: （影集、廣播等的）一集、一段插曲
example: I can't wait to watch the next episode.
description: 我等不及要看下一集了。

example: One plus one equals two.
description: 一加一等於二。

example: The money was divided equally between them.
description: 錢在他們之間被平均分配了。

example: The bird managed to escape from the cage.
description: 那隻鳥設法從籠子裡逃走了。

example: Water is essential for life.
description: 水是生命不可或缺的。

example: Keep trying, and you will succeed eventually.
description: 繼續努力，你最終會成功的。

example: I like all fruit except bananas.
description: 除了香蕉，我喜歡所有的水果。

example: We can exchange ideas during the meeting.
description: 我們可以在會議期間交流想法。

example: The children were full of excitement before the trip.
description: 孩子們在旅行前充滿了興奮。

example: There is a new art exhibition at the gallery.
description: 藝廊有一個新的藝術展覽。

example: The emergency exit is at the back of the building.
description: 緊急出口在建築物後方。

example: The company is looking to expand into new markets.
description: 公司正尋求擴張到新市場。

example: The expected delivery date is next Monday.
description: 預計的送達日期是下週一。

example: Have you ever experienced an earthquake?
description: 你曾經經歷過地震嗎？

example: She is a very experienced teacher.
description: 她是一位非常有經驗的老師。

example: Scientists are experimenting with new drugs.
description: 科學家們正在對新藥物進行實驗。

example: The bomb exploded in the early morning.
description: 炸彈在清晨爆炸了。

example: We spent the day exploring the city.
description: 我們花了一天的時間探索這座城市。

example: There was a loud explosion in the factory.
description: 工廠裡發生了一聲巨大的爆炸。

example: This country exports a lot of fruit.
description: 這個國家出口很多水果。

example: It will cost an extra ten dollars.
description: 這將額外花費十美元。

example: The test was fairly easy.
description: 這次測試相當簡單。

example: Your face looks very familiar to me.
description: 你的臉對我來說看起來非常眼熟（熟悉）。

example: We went to a fancy restaurant for our anniversary.
description: 我們去了一家高級餐廳慶祝週年紀念。

example: The station is not far from here.
description: 車站離這裡不遠。

example: I found the story absolutely fascinating.
description: 我覺得這個故事非常迷人。

example: It's not very fashionable to wear that anymore.
description: 現在穿那個已經不太時髦了。

example: Please fasten your seat belts.
description: 請繫好您的安全帶。

example: Can you do me a favor?
description: 你能幫我一個忙嗎？

description: 許多人害怕蜘蛛。

example: The movie features a famous French actor.
description: 這部電影由一位著名的法國演員主演。

example: They work for the federal government.
description: 他們為聯邦政府工作。

example: He painted the wooden fence white.
description: 他把木籬笆漆成了白色。

example: The fighting lasted for several days.
description: 戰鬥持續了幾天。

example: She is seeking financial advice.
description: 她正在尋求財務建議。

example: Running is a great way to improve your fitness.
description: 跑步是增進健康的好方法。

example: The price is fixed; you can't bargain.
description: 價格是固定的，你不能討價還價。

example: The national flag was flying in the wind.
description: 國旗在風中飄揚。

example: The heavy rain caused a serious flood.

description: 你可以把外套掛在門後。

description: 我面試前需要燙一下襯衫。

description: 這是一個非常敏感的議題。

description: 她在資訊科技部門工作。

description: 他在歐洲旅行期間寫了旅遊日誌。

description: 祝你旅途平安。

description: 你不應該以貌取人（根據外表判斷人）。

description: 她將數據輸入電腦。

description: 我需要一個新的無線鍵盤。

description: 他把球踢進了球門。

example: What is the company's policy on smoking?
description: 公司關於吸菸的政策是什麼？

example: He is very interested in political news.
description: 他對政治新聞非常感興趣。

example: The politicians are debating the new law.
description: 政治人物們正在辯論新法律。

example: She decided to go into politics.
description: 她決定從政（進入政治圈）。

example: The ship arrived at the port this morning.
description: 船今天早上抵達了港口。

example: There is a large portrait of the king in the hall.
description: 大廳裡掛著一張巨大的國王肖像。

example: Can you possibly help me with this?
description: 你有可能幫我處理這個嗎？

example: I'll make a pot of tea.
description: 我來泡一壺茶。

example: Please pour me a glass of water.
description: 請幫我倒一杯水。

example: Many people live in poverty in that region.
description: 該地區有許多人生活在貧困中。

example: Mix the soap powder with warm water.
description: 將肥皂粉與溫水混合。

example: The car has a very powerful engine.
description: 這輛車有一個強勁的引擎。

example: You need practical experience for this job.
description: 這份工作需要實際經驗。

example: They go to church to pray every Sunday.
description: 他們每個週日都去教堂祈禱。

example: She said a quick prayer before the exam.
description: 她在考試前做了一個簡短的祈禱。

example: It's hard to make a prediction about the weather.
description: 很難對天氣做出預測。

example: Are you prepared for the meeting?
description: 你為開會做好準備了嗎？

example: I have to give a presentation tomorrow.
description: 我明天必須做一個簡報報告。

example: Press the button to start the machine.
description: 按下按鈕啟動機器。

example: He is under a lot of pressure at work.
description: 他的工作壓力很大。

example: She pretended that she didn't hear me.
description: 她假裝沒聽到我說話。

example: Do you have any previous experience?
description: 你有任何先前的經驗嗎？

example: She previously worked as a teacher.
description: 她以前擔任過老師。

example: The priest spoke to the children about kindness.
description: 牧師向孩子們談論仁慈。

example: His primary goal is to finish college.
description: 他的主要目標是完成大學學業。

example: The prince married the princess in a fairy tale.
description: 童話故事中王子娶了公主。

example: The princess wore a beautiful gold crown.
description: 公主戴著一頂美麗的金皇冠。

example: I have an appointment with the school principal.
description: 我和學校校長有約。

example: The printing of the book took several months.
description: 這本書的印刷花了幾個月時間。

example: The prisoners were released after the war.
description: 戰後囚犯們被釋放了。

example: This is a private conversation.
description: 這是私人對話。

example: He is a famous movie producer.
description: 他是一位著名的電影製作人。

example: Production of the new car will start next year.
description: 新車的生產將於明年開始。

example: She is a lawyer by profession.
description: 她的職業是律師。

example: The company made a large profit last year.
description: 公司去年賺取了巨額利潤。

example: He taught himself how to program computers.
description: 他自學如何編寫電腦程式。

example: She was promoted to manager last week.
description: 她上週被晉升為經理。

example: You need the proper tools for the job.
description: 做這項工作需要適當的工具。

example: The machine is not working properly.
description: 機器運作不正常（不正確地）。

example: This house is private property.
description: 這棟房子是私人財產。

example: There was a large protest against the new tax.
description: 有一場反對新稅收的大型抗議活動。

example: I'm so proud of your achievement.
description: 我為你的成就感到非常自豪。

example: Can you prove that you were there?
description: 你能證明你當時在那裡嗎？

example: Give the door a hard pull.
description: 使勁拉一下門。

example: You shouldn't punish him for a small mistake.
description: 你不應該因為一個小錯誤而懲罰他。

example: What is the punishment for this crime?
description: 這項罪行的懲罰是什麼？

example: Give the car a push to help it start.
description: 推一下這輛車以幫助它發動。

example: What qualifications do you need for this job?
description: 這份工作需要什麼樣的資格或學歷？

example: She is a highly qualified teacher.
description: 她是一位非常有資格（優秀）的老師。

example: You need to pass this test to qualify for the competition.
description: 你需要通過這次測試才能取得參賽資格。

example: He decided to quit his job and travel the world.
description: 他決定辭掉工作去環遊世界。

example: The book begins with a quotation from Shakespeare.
description: 這本書以莎士比亞的一段引文開頭。

example: Can I quote you on that?
description: 我可以引用你說的那句話嗎？

example: People of many different races live in this city.
description: 許多不同種族的人居住在這座城市。

example: He enjoys horse racing.
description: 他喜歡賽馬活動。

example: I’m going to ask my boss for a raise.
description: 我打算向老闆要求加薪。

example: The hotel offers a wide range of activities.
description: 飯店提供多樣化的（一系列）活動。

example: It is very rare to see a snow leopard.
description: 見到雪豹是非常罕見的。

example: We rarely go out for dinner during the week.
description: 我們平日很少出去吃晚餐。

example: What was his reaction to the news?
description: 他對那個消息有什麼反應？

example: His dream finally became a reality.
description: 他的夢想終於變成了現實。

example: Do you have the receipt for the dress?
description: 你有這件洋裝的收據嗎？

example: I bought this book on your recommendation.
description: 我是根據你的推薦買這本書的。

example: The book is a useful work of reference.
description: 這本書是一本非常有用的參考工具書。

example: The calm water reflected the trees.
description: 平靜的水面映照出（反射）樹木。

example: You should exercise regularly.
description: 你應該規律地運動。

example: They rejected our offer to help.
description: 他們拒絕了我們提供的協助。

example: How does this relate to the project?
description: 這跟專案有什麼關聯？

example: Are you two related?
description: 你們兩個有親戚關係嗎？

example: We have good relations with our neighbors.
description: 我們與鄰居關係良好。

example: She invited all her relatives to the party.
description: 她邀請了所有親戚參加派對。

example: He felt very relaxed after the holiday.
description: 度假後他感到非常放鬆。

example: Listening to music is very relaxing.
description: 聽音樂非常令人放鬆。

example: The company will release a new version of the software.
description: 公司將發布軟體的新版本。

example: He is a very reliable employee.
description: 他是一位非常可靠的員工。

example: Freedom of religion is important.
description: 宗教自由很重要。

example: They are a very religious family.
description: 他們是一個非常虔誠的家庭。

example: Please remain seated until the plane stops.
description: 在飛機停止前，請保持在座位上（坐好）。

example: Please remind me to call my mother.
description: 請提醒我打電話給我媽媽。

example: They live in a remote mountain village.
description: 他們住在一個偏遠的山村。

example: How much is the rent for this apartment?
description: 這間公寓的租金是多少？

example: The car is in need of repair.
description: 這輛車需要修理。

example: This movie is a repeat from last year.
description: 這部電影是去年的重播片。

example: There have been repeated complaints about the noise.
description: 已經有多次關於噪音的投訴。

example: Each color on the map represents a different country.
description: 地圖上的每種顏色代表一個不同的國家。

example: We requested more information about the product.
description: 我們請求獲得更多關於該產品的資訊。

example: The job requires a lot of hard work.
description: 這份工作需要付出很多努力。

example: I'd like to make a reservation for a table of four.
description: 我想預訂一張四人桌。

example: The library is a great resource for students.
description: 圖書館對學生來說是個很棒的資源。

example: You should show respect to your teachers.
description: 你應該對老師表現出尊重。

example: It's your responsibility to finish the work on time.
description: 準時完成工作是你的責任。

example: Who is responsible for this mistake?
description: 誰應該對這個錯誤負責？

example: The accident resulted in serious injuries.
description: 事故導致了嚴重的傷害。

example: He plans to retire next year.
description: 他計畫明年退休。

example: My father is a retired doctor.
description: 我父親是一位退休醫生。

example: I need to revise my essay before I hand it in.
description: 我在交作業前需要修改（修訂）我的論文。

example: Did you hear the ring of the doorbell?
description: 你有聽到門鈴聲嗎？

example: There is a risk of fire in this building.
description: 這棟建築有火災風險。

example: Robots are used in many factories nowadays.
description: 現今許多工廠都在使用機器人。

example: The ball rolled under the table.
description: 球滾到了桌子底下。

example: We had a romantic dinner by the beach.
description: 我們在海邊吃了一頓浪漫的晚餐。

example: They used a rope to climb the mountain.
description: 他們用繩索爬山。

chinese: 粗糙的、粗略的、波濤洶湧的
example: The sea was very rough today.
description: 今天海面上波濤洶湧。

example: We sat in the front row of the theater.
description: 我們坐在劇院的第一排。

example: They visited the royal palace in London.
description: 他們參觀了倫敦的皇宮。

example: The king ruled the country for fifty years.
description: 國王統治了這個國家五十年。

example: Your safety is our number one priority.
description: 您的安全是我們的首要任務。

example: The sails of the boat were white.
description: 那艘船的帆是白色的。

example: He spent most of his life as a sailor.
description: 他一生中大部分時間都擔任水手。

example: We need a sample of the water to test it.
description: 我們需要一份水樣進行測試。

example: The children were playing in the sand on the beach.
description: 孩子們正在沙灘上的沙子裡玩耍。

example: I’ll scan the document and email it to you.
description: 我會掃描這份文件然後寄給你。

example: There is no scientific evidence for this theory.
description: 這項理論沒有科學證據支持。

example: The actors are reading through the script.
description: 演員們正在研讀劇本。

example: We saw an amazing modern sculpture in the park.
description: 我們在公園裡看到了一件很棒的現代雕塑作品。

chinese: 次要的、中等的 (中學教育)
example: He is a secondary school teacher.
description: 他是一位中學老師。

example: Security at the airport is very tight.
description: 機場的安檢（保全）非常嚴密。

example: I planted some flower seeds in the garden.
description: 我在花園裡種了一些花種子。

example: That seems like a sensible decision.
description: 那看起來是個明智的決定。

example: The river separates the two cities.
description: 這條河將這兩座城市分隔開來。

example: You should take your studies more seriously.
description: 你應該更認真地看待你的學業。

example: In the past, many rich families had servants.
description: 在過去，許多富裕家庭都有僕人。

example: Please set the table for dinner.
description: 請擺好晚餐的餐具。

example: I bought a new set of golf clubs.
description: 我買了一套新的高爾夫球桿。

example: The hotel is in a beautiful rural setting.
description: 這家飯店座落於美麗的鄉村環境中。

example: Please state your sex on the form.
description: 請在表格上註明您的性別。

example: They are discussing sexual equality in the workplace.
description: 他們正在討論職場中的性別平等（兩性平等）。

example: Would you like a chocolate shake?
description: 你想要一杯巧克力奶昔嗎？

example: He owns a large share of the company.
description: 他擁有該公司大量的股份。

example: Be careful; the knife is very sharp.
description: 小心，這把刀非常鋒利。

example: Put the books back on the shelf.
description: 把書放回書架上。

example: We found some beautiful shells on the beach.
description: 我們在沙灘上發現了一些美麗的貝殼。

example: She works the night shift at the hospital.
description: 她在醫院值夜班。

example: The sun was shining brightly this morning.
description: 今天早上陽光燦爛。

example: I like your shiny new shoes.
description: 我喜歡你那雙閃亮的新鞋。

example: They are going to shoot a movie in this town.
description: 他們打算在這個小鎮拍攝電影。

example: He is a very shy boy who doesn't talk much.
description: 他是一個非常害羞且話不多的男孩。

example: She lost her sight in an accident.
description: 她在一場事故中失明（失去了視力）。

example: A red light is a signal to stop.
description: 紅燈是停止的信號。

example: The house was completely silent.
description: 房子裡安靜極了（完全無聲）。

example: Don't be silly; of course I'll help you.
description: 別傻了（別糊塗），我當然會幫你。

example: I can see a strong similarity between the two brothers.
description: 我能看出這兩兄弟之間有很強的相似之處。

example: My father was a doctor, and similarly, I became one too.
description: 我父親是醫生，同樣地，我也成了一名醫生。

example: I simply don't have the time to go.
description: 我簡直沒時間去。

example: He left school in 2010 and has worked here ever since.
description: 他 2010 年畢業，自那以後就一直在這裡工作。

example: The sun was sinking below the horizon.
description: 太陽正沉向地平線。

example: In the past, many people were treated as slaves.
description: 在過去，許多人被當作奴隸對待。

example: Would you like another slice of cake?
description: 你想再吃一片蛋糕嗎？

example: I'm feeling slightly better today.
description: 我今天感覺好一點點了。

example: The car slowed down as it approached the corner.
description: 車子在靠近轉角時減速了。

example: The flight was very smooth.
description: 飛行過程非常順利（平穩）。

example: I need to install some new software on my computer.
description: 我需要在電腦上安裝一些新軟體。

example: The soil here is very good for growing vegetables.
description: 這裡的土壤非常適合種蔬菜。

example: Ice is solid water.
description: 冰是固態的水。

example: I need to sort these files into order.
description: 我需要按順序整理這些檔案。

example: They live in the southern part of the country.
description: 他們住在該國的南部地區。

example: This course is designed specifically for beginners.
description: 這門課程是特別為初學者設計的。

example: The government is trying to reduce its spending.
description: 政府正試圖減少其支出。

example: I don't like spicy food very much.
description: 我不是很喜歡辛辣的食物。

example: You have a very strong spirit.
description: 你有一股很強的韌性（精神）。

example: He has good spoken English.
description: 他的英語口說很好。

example: This is a beautiful spot for a wedding.
description: 這是一個舉行婚禮的美麗地點。

example: The news spread quickly through the village.
description: 消息很快在村子裡傳開了。

example: He sprang out of bed when the alarm went off.
description: 鬧鐘響時，他從床上跳了起來。

example: The football match was held at the national stadium.
description: 足球比賽在國家體育場舉行。

example: The school has a very friendly staff.
description: 這所學校的教職員非常友善。

example: Her work is of a very high standard.
description: 她的工作表現有很高的水準。

example: Please state your name and address.
description: 請說明您的姓名和地址。

example: These statistics show that crime is falling.
description: 這些統計數字顯示犯罪率正在下降。

example: There is a statue of a famous poet in the square.
description: 廣場上有一座著名詩人的雕像。

example: He used glue to stick the pieces together.
description: 他用膠水把碎片黏在一起。

example: He used a stick to help him walk.
description: 他用手杖（棍子）輔助走路。

example: Please stand still while I take your photo.
description: 我幫你拍照時，請站著別動（保持靜止）。

example: You can store your photos on the cloud.
description: 你可以將照片儲存在雲端。

example: You shouldn't talk to strangers.
description: 你不應該和陌生人說話。

example: He didn't have the strength to lift the box.
description: 他沒有力氣搬起那個箱子。

example: I strongly advise you to see a doctor.
description: 我強烈建議你去看看醫生。

example: The artist spends all day in his studio.
description: 那位藝術家整天待在他的工作室裡。

example: What's all this stuff on the floor?
description: 地板上這些東西是什麼？

example: It was a sticky, brown substance.
description: 那是一種黏糊糊的褐色物質。

example: He successfully completed the marathon.
description: 他成功完成了馬拉松。

example: There was a sudden change in the weather.
description: 天氣發生了突然的變化。

example: Many people suffer from headaches.
description: 許多人深受頭痛之苦。

example: That blue dress really suits you.
description: 那件藍色洋裝真的很適合你。

example: This movie is not suitable for young children.
description: 這部電影不適合年幼的孩子看。

example: Can you summarize the main points of the talk?
description: 你能總結一下這次談話的要點嗎？

example: Please write a short summary of the story.
description: 請寫一段這個故事的簡短摘要。

example: The company supplies office equipment.
description: 這家公司供應辦公設備。

example: He is a strong supporter of the project.
description: 他是這個專案的堅定支持者。

example: Surely you agree with me.
description: 你無疑（肯定）會同意我的看法。

example: The surface of the table was scratched.
description: 桌子的表面被刮傷了。

example: It's a miracle that they survived the accident.
description: 他們在那場事故中倖存下來簡直是個奇蹟。

example: Let's go for a swim in the lake.
description: 我們去湖裡游個泳吧。

example: Can we switch seats?
description: 我們可以換一下座位嗎？

example: A fever is a common symptom of the flu.
description: 發燒是流感的一個常見症狀。

example: The dog wagged its tail when it saw me.
description: 那隻狗看到我時搖了搖尾巴。

example: She has a real talent for music.
description: 她很有音樂天賦。

example: He is one of the most talented players on the team.
description: 他是隊中更有才華的球員之一。

example: Use some tape to fix the picture to the wall.
description: 用膠帶把畫固定在牆上。

example: The government is planning to increase the tax on cigarettes.
description: 政府計畫增加香菸稅。

example: The machine is complicated and requires technical knowledge.
description: 這台機器很複雜，需要專門的技術知識。

example: She has a very good piano technique.
description: 她的鋼琴演奏技巧非常好。

example: I tend to get tired in the afternoon.
description: 我下午往往會感到疲倦。

example: We slept in a tent during our camping trip.
description: 露營時我們睡在帳篷裡。

example: It's not that cold today.
description: 今天沒那麼冷。

example: That car is theirs, not ours.
description: 那輛車是他們的，不是我們的。

example: The theme of the party was "the 1920s".
description: 派對的主題是「1920 年代」。

example: He developed a new theory about the origin of the universe.
description: 他提出了關於宇宙起源的新理論。

example: He was ill and therefore couldn't come.
description: 他生病了，因此不能來。

example: I didn't think the test would be this easy.
description: 我沒想到考試會這麼容易。

example: Though it was raining, we went out for a walk.
description: 儘管在下雨，我們還是出去散步了。

example: I have a sore throat and a cough.
description: 我喉嚨痛且咳嗽。

example: It rained throughout the night.
description: 雨下了一整夜（貫穿整個晚上）。

example: These shoes are a bit tight.
description: 這雙鞋有點緊。

example: I'll be at work till 6 o'clock.
description: 我會工作到 6 點。

example: The baby has tiny hands and feet.
description: 寶寶的手腳非常小巧。

example: Did you tip the waiter?
description: 你給服務生小費了嗎？

example: I have a flat tire and need to change it.
description: 我的輪胎沒電了（爆胎），需要更換。

example: She stubbed her toe on the leg of the table.
description: 她的腳趾撞到了桌腳。

example: The truck can carry up to five tons.
description: 這輛卡車最多可載重五噸。

example: English is my mother tongue.
description: 英語是我的母語（母舌）。

example: What is the total cost of the trip?
description: 這次旅行的總費用是多少？

example: I totally agree with you.
description: 我完全同意你的看法。

example: The fabric is soft to the touch.
description: 這種布料摸起來很柔軟。

example: The band is touring Europe this summer.
description: 該樂團今年夏天在歐洲巡迴演出。

example: Trade between the two countries has increased.
description: 兩國之間的貿易往來有所增加。

example: I bought a new pair of trainers for the gym.
description: 我買了一雙新的運動鞋要去健身房穿。

example: Can you translate this letter into English for me?
description: 你能幫我把這封信翻譯成英文嗎？

example: This is a very good translation of the novel.
description: 這是該小說一個非常好的譯本。

example: The goods are transported by ship.
description: 貨物是透過船隻運送的。

example: You should treat others with respect.
description: 你應該尊重地對待他人。

example: He is receiving treatment for his back pain.
description: 他正在接受背痛治療。

example: There is a growing trend toward healthy eating.
description: 健康飲食的趨勢正日益增長。

example: He played a trick on his friend.
description: 他對他的朋友惡作劇。

example: It's important to tell the truth.
description: 說實話是很重要的。

example: We took the tube to get to the city center.
description: 我們搭地鐵去市中心。

example: How fast can you type?
description: 你打字有多快？

example: A meal here typically costs about $20.
description: 這裡的一餐通常花費約 20 美元。

example: That's an ugly building.
description: 那是一棟很難看的建築。

example: I am unable to come to the meeting tomorrow.
description: 我明天無法來開會。

example: This chair is very uncomfortable.
description: 這張椅子很不舒服。

example: He packed some clean underwear for the trip.
description: 他為旅行打包了一些乾淨的內衣。

example: He has been unemployed for six months.
description: 他已經失業六個月了。

example: Unemployment is a serious problem in this region.
description: 失業在該地區是一個嚴重的問題。

example: It was unfair of him to blame you.
description: 他責怪你是不公平的。

example: He is a member of the teachers' union.
description: 他是教師工會的成員。

example: I won't go unless you come with me.
description: 除非你跟我一起去，否則我不去。

example: Unlike his brother, he is very shy.
description: 不像他的哥哥，他非常害羞。

example: It's unlikely that it will rain today.
description: 今天不太可能下雨。

example: It was an unnecessary expense.
description: 那是一筆不必要的開銷。

example: There was an unpleasant smell in the room.
description: 房間裡有一股令人不快的味道。

example: You need to update your software.
description: 你需要更新你的軟體。

example: He placed the book upon the table.
description: 他把書放在桌上。

example: She was very upset when she heard the news.
description: 她聽到消息時感到非常難過（心煩）。

example: He bought a used car to save money.
description: 為了省錢，他買了一輛二手車。

example: She has a collection of valuable paintings.
description: 她收藏了一些名貴（有價值）的畫作。

example: The value of the house has increased.
description: 這房子的價值增加了。

example: I have various reasons for leaving.
description: 我離開有各種各樣的理由。

example: I have the latest version of the software.
description: 我有該軟體的最新版本。

example: The victim of the accident was taken to the hospital.
description: 事故的受害者被送往醫院。

example: You can view the video on our website.
description: 您可以在我們的網站上觀看這段影片。

example: Millions of viewers watched the live broadcast.
description: 數百萬名觀眾收看了現場直播。

example: The movie was criticized for being too violent.
description: 這部電影因過於暴力而受到批評。

example: She works as a volunteer at the hospital.
description: 她在醫院擔任志工。

example: Are you going to vote in the election?
description: 你會在這場選舉中投票嗎？

example: Come inside and warm yourself by the fire.
description: 進來靠近火堆讓自己暖和一下。

example: I warned him not to go out alone at night.
description: 我警告過他晚上不要獨自出去。

example: The doctor gave him a serious warning about his health.
description: 醫生對他的健康狀況發出了嚴重的警告。

example: Don't waste your time on this.
description: 不要浪費時間在這上面。

example: Remember to water the plants every day.
description: 記得每天給植物澆水。

example: She waved goodbye as the train left.
description: 火車離開時她揮手道別。

example: Police are looking for the murder weapon.
description: 警方正在尋找謀殺凶器（武器）。

example: How much do you weigh?
description: 你體重多少？

example: I enjoy watching western movies.
description: 我喜歡看西方（西部）電影。

example: You can eat whatever you want.
description: 你想吃什麼都可以。

example: I'm here for you whenever you need me.
description: 無論你何時需要我，我都會在你身邊。

example: I don't know whether he will come or not.
description: 我不知道他是否會來。

example: I haven't seen her for a while.
description: 我已經有好一段時間沒見過她了。

example: Two halves make a whole.
description: 兩個一半構成一個整體。

example: Where there's a will, there's a way.
description: 有志者事竟成（哪裡有意志，哪裡就有出路）。

example: It was a great win for our team.
description: 這對我們隊來說是一次了不起的勝利。

example: The bird has beautiful blue wings.
description: 那隻鳥有美麗的藍色翅膀。

example: The work will be finished within a week.
description: 工作將在一個星期內完成。

example: I wonder why she's late.
description: 我納悶她為什麼遲到。

example: This sweater is made of pure wool.
description: 這件毛衣是純羊毛做的。

example: The company has a worldwide reputation.
description: 這家公司享譽全球。

example: Health is her main worry.
description: 健康是她主要的憂慮。

example: He's playing worse than yesterday.
description: 他今天玩得比昨天更糟。

example: Of all the players, he played worst.
description: 在所有球員中，他表現得最差（最糟）。

example: This movie is well worth watching.
description: 這部電影非常值得一看。

example: We need a written agreement.
description: 我們需要一份書面協議。

example: I think I've done something wrong.
description: 我覺得我做錯了某些事。

example: It's a popular club among the young.
description: 這是一家在年輕人中很受歡迎的俱樂部。

example: She spent her youth in France.
description: 她的青春歲月在法國度過。
